investigation.question: Investigate the unusual login for user_01 on 2024-01-22T03:10:00Z from a new device accessing a rarely used resource.

claims.text: Login event EVT-999001 exists for user_01 at 2024-01-22T03:10:00Z from device_new_laptop with source IP 10.0.5.50, outcome success.
The login event EVT-999001 has device_id = device_new_laptop.
The login event EVT-999001 has timestamp = 2024-01-22T03:10:00Z.
The login event EVT-999001 has source_ip = 10.0.5.50.
The login event EVT-999001 has outcome = success.
Resource access event EVT-999002 exists for user_01 at 2024-01-22T03:12:00Z from device_new_laptop accessing aws_console, outcome success.
The resource access event EVT-999002 has resource = aws_console.
Login event EVT-999001 (03:10:00Z) precedes resource access event EVT-999002 (03:12:00Z).
Device device_new_laptop is not present in the baseline known_devices list (cutoff 2024-01-21T00:00:00Z), indicating it is a new/unfamiliar device for user_01.
claims.limitations: Baseline known_devices shows device_user_01_1, device_user_01_new_4872, device_user_01_new_5415, device_user_01_new_3068 only.

claims.text: IT ticket CTX-999001 approved on 2024-01-21T14:00:00Z for laptop replacement, issuing device_new_laptop to user_01.
Approved device record CTX-999002 on 2024-01-21T14:05:00Z confirms device_new_laptop approved for user_01.
Login hour 03:00 UTC has only 1 prior event in baseline histogram (index 3 value 1), making this hour unusual but not unprecedented.

Resource aws_console does not appear in baseline top_resources (top: salesforce 21, jira 13, gcp_console 13, confluence 13, pagerduty 13, office365 2, slack 2, bamboohr 1), indicating it is rarely used by this user.
claims.limitations: Baseline top_resources list does not include aws_console.

claims.text: Hypothesis: The new device login and rare resource access are explained by legitimate laptop replacement approved via IT ticket CTX-999001 and approved_device CTX-999002.
Missing evidence: No prior login events from device_new_laptop before 2024-01-22T03:10:00Z (this is the first observed use).
claims.limitations: Query window started at 2024-01-22T00:00:00Z; baseline cutoff is 2024-01-21T00:00:00Z.

hypotheses.description: Legitimate laptop replacement explains the new device login and subsequent AWS console access.

missing_evidence: No prior login events from device_new_laptop before 2024-01-22T03:10:00Z (first observed use).
No baseline data for aws_console access frequency (not in top_resources).
Source IP 10.0.5.50 not verified against known corporate ranges.
next_steps: Verify source IP 10.0.5.50 belongs to expected corporate network segment.
Confirm with IT that device_new_laptop was physically delivered to user_01 before 2024-01-22T03:10:00Z.
Review aws_console access patterns for user_01 over longer period to determine if truly rare.

conclusion.label: likely_benign
conclusion.rationale: The new device login at an unusual hour (03:10 UTC) and access to a rarely used resource (aws_console) are explained by an approved IT ticket (CTX-999001) and approved_device record (CTX-999002) for a laptop replacement issued on 2024-01-21. The login succeeded from an internal IP (10.0.5.50) and was followed by expected resource access. While the hour and resource are deviations from baseline, a consistent legitimate explanation exists in the records.
